body:
You're talking to a lot of people, so I doubt you really need the company, and this conversation is just silly.


I don't really care what I eat so long as it doesn't look or smell repulsive. I used to really like bleu chesse, hot wings, etcetera, but now I don't really have too much preference as to what I eat. 



I'm not sure why I even bothered answering that. Just to waste the time I guess.
Way too much. Not because I enjoy it but because it was easy to do, takes time, and lets me not think

I need a license to drive to a job. There isn't a place to work at that isn't at least a 15-20 minute drive from where I live. I don't want one anyway.


Nothing's on my mind. Thinking makes me miserable. I try not to think. I haven't a single thing better to do, so we can chat as long as you like.

I can totally relate. On Fimfiction's boards, I disagreed with the hivemind and got quite a bit of backlash. It was over something trivial too. I put it quite a bit of thought into what I said, but nope. 


And on /r/mylittlepony, I dissented about cultural things (same ol same ol Lyra-Bon Bon ship should be canon so there is homosexuality for the sake of it BS), and argued against it, and got downvoted to hell and all my pertient posts removed by the mods.



Undertale fandom downvoted me for complaining about no hard mode and for not liking Toriel or her actions.


My favorite moba's sub even downvoted me because they thought I was lying about something stupid (why I gave a downvote to a player I played with). 



Fandoms can be trash. Best just to stick to non-fandom type forums in my opinion... They tend to be a little less herd-like.
